title: Resolve explicitly recorded qualification and delivery gates
reason: Current assessment — 2026-11-10, 00c3fe3. Open, evidence review — current requirements still distinguish planned selection, testing and delivery from achieved results. Findings have been deduplicated and relocated to current paths; keyword matches about pending input, unresolved operations and unqualified globals are design rules, not evidence of an open delivery gate. Approval of technical narratives does not establish test success.

Open — Abacus 3.0 addresses 1980 business workflows. Broader nested-data/query capabilities and direct competition with the historical 1983 Lotus 1-2-3 belong to a later Abacus version; its number and release date remain unspecified.

Open — Review each controller pilot independently for electrical equivalence, yield, reliability and test coverage. Release only passing parts. Continue ERA and support-chip engineering lots; preserve AION supply for unqualified parts.

Open — Approve initial country configurations and local platform editions, complete warranty/support ownership, stock allocation, dealer/instructor readiness and country configuration sheets. Reserve production at demand plus 5% headroom once country demand is assessed; do not add 5% to sales. AION is the fallback for SGS-unqualified parts. Delay only failing configurations, keeping Logix/third-party complements available.

Open — Central scenario date, conditional on qualification: launch a business PC with a substitute independently commissioned disk OS and an initially narrower application portfolio. Supplier and OS name remain unspecified. Brand, service and dealer reach win buyers; no CP/M-86, QDOS acquisition or immediate mature MS-DOS ecosystem.

Open — Present ERA² at 12 MHz target (16 MHz stretch), Athena 256 KiB / 5 MB HDD and Athena Server 1 MiB / 20 MB HDD. Both include 64 KiB graphics, one 5.25-inch DS/DD floppy and one network card. EEPROM BIOS plus 256 KiB directly executable AIONix2 system ROM. Protected multitasking, legacy ERA ABI, recoverable HDD storage, users and layered TUI are accepted design targets, pending implementation qualification. Conference runs 16–19 May in Anaheim; premiere does not certify volume shipments.
Open — Academy offices are combined with regional sales offices equipped and staffed to sell computers directly to institutional clients. Specific office locations remain unspecified.
